headline: Solventum Announces Intent to Separate its Health Information Systems Business
summary: Solventum (NYSE: SOLV) today announced its intention to pursue a separation of its Health Information Systems business as part of the company's ongoing portfolio optimization strategy. The company will evaluate a range of separation pathways with the objective of maximizing shareholder value that position both Solventum and Health Information Systems for long-term success.
